overall: The AG found the Airport Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the individual conversations involved fewer than a quorum and were not relayed to a quorum, and no emails were exchanged.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged commission members deliberated outside a properly posted meeting on February 4, 5, and 7, 2014, including by email.
allegations.key_passage: The content of these individual conversations was not shared or otherwise discussed with a quorum of the Commission, either in person or by email.
